title: Apply for the National Energy Bill Relief payment for small business
summary: Find out if your small business is eligible for the National Energy Bill Relief payment and how to apply.
intro: The Australian Government has announced that eligible small businesses will receive up to $150 to help with the cost of their electricity bills in the 2025–26 financial year.
who_can_apply: Must have an active Australian Business Number (ABN).
Must be named on the electricity bill or account.
Must be on a separately metered business tariff.
Must have an annual electricity consumption below 100 MWh.
Cannot operate from a home or be on a residential electricity tariff.
Exclusions include post offices, government-owned agencies, gas and water retailers, and telecommunications companies.
what_you_need: Electricity bill or account showing the business name.
Confirmation of a separately metered business tariff.
Record of annual electricity consumption (below 100 MWh).

faqs.q: What is the National Energy Bill Relief payment?
faqs.a: Eligible small businesses can receive up to $150 to help with the cost of their electricity bills in the 2025–26 financial year.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for this payment?
faqs.a: To be eligible, your small business must have an active ABN, be named on the electricity bill or account, be on a separately metered business tariff, and have an annual electricity consumption below 100 MWh. You are not eligible if you operate from home or if your business is on a residential electricity tariff.
The listed providers include ARC Energy Group, Energy Locals/ Energy Locals Urban, Energy On, Evergy, Origin Energy, Microgrid Power, and Locality Planning Energy (LPE) at specific sites.
